name: Christmas PFP: Turn Your Photo Into a Christmas Profile Picture
blurb: A Christmas pfp is a Christmas version of your profile picture, and the trend is to switch to one on 1 November.

prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Turn this photo into a cozy Christmas profile picture of the same person. Add a classic red Santa hat with a thick white fur trim and a white pompom, sitting naturally on the head over the subject's own hair, the trim above the eyebrows so the forehead line, the brows and the eyes stay fully visible. Add soft falling snow and warm fairy lights behind. Keep the face the same, with the same expression as in the photo. Compose it as a profile picture: a head-and-shoulders portrait, the face in the exact center of the frame and looking into the camera, the whole hat in view with a little room above the pompom, so a round or square profile picture crop keeps the whole head and the hat. Behind the subject: a softly blurred cozy winter evening with warm golden fairy lights glowing as round bokeh and a hint of a decorated Christmas tree, and big soft snowflakes falling in front of and behind the subject, a few resting on the hat and the shoulders. Keep the person's own clothes from the photo; only if the clothes do not show, a plain cream knit sweater. Warm, soft, flattering light on the face from the fairy lights and a soft front light, a small catchlight in each eye, natural skin texture and true skin color, sharp focus on the eyes. Photo realistic, like a real phone portrait taken on a winter evening, not a painting. Exactly one person. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no sticker, no frame and no border.

Use the uploaded image as the base. Redraw this photo as a cute Christmas cartoon profile picture of the same person, in our own illustrated style: clean, smooth dark outlines, soft cel shading, warm cozy colors, a slightly bigger head, big friendly eyes with a highlight, rosy cheeks and a simple small nose and mouth. The cartoon wears a classic red Santa hat with a thick white fur trim and a white pompom, sitting naturally on the head over the subject's own hair, the trim above the eyebrows so the forehead line, the brows and the eyes stay fully visible. The cartoon keeps everything that makes the person recognizable, as simple cartoon shapes: the face shape, the exact hairstyle, hair length and hair color, any beard, moustache or stubble, glasses, earrings and freckles, the skin tone, the age look, the gender, the expression, and the clothes with their colors from the photo. Exactly one character. Compose it as a profile picture: a head-and-shoulders portrait, the face in the exact center of the frame and looking into the camera, the whole hat in view with a little room above the pompom, so a round or square profile picture crop keeps the whole head and the hat. Behind, in the same flat cartoon style: a deep blue winter night with big round snowflakes, a small decorated Christmas tree and a string of warm colored lights. No existing cartoon, anime, game or movie character and no known studio's character design: only a cartoon of the person in the photo. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no sticker, no frame and no border. The face is always a hand-drawn cartoon face in this style, never a photo face: the identity rules below apply to the cartoon's face shape, hair, facial hair, glasses, skin tone, age, gender and clothes.

Use the two uploaded images. Make a matching pair of cozy Christmas profile pictures in one picture: two square portraits stacked one above the other, split by a thin straight white line across the middle, so each square can be cropped as its own profile picture. The TOP square is the subject from image 1. The BOTTOM square is the subject from image 2. Each square shows only its own subject. Both portraits match: each subject wears a classic red Santa hat with a thick white fur trim and a white pompom, sitting naturally on the head over the subject's own hair, the trim above the eyebrows so the forehead line, the brows and the eyes stay fully visible, with the same cozy background, the same light, the same colors and the same framing. In each square: a head-and-shoulders portrait, the face in the center of the square and looking into the camera, the whole hat in view. Behind each subject: a softly blurred cozy winter evening with warm golden fairy lights as round bokeh, a hint of a decorated Christmas tree, and big soft snowflakes falling, a few on the hat and the shoulders. Each person keeps their own face, hair, glasses, facial hair, skin tone, age and their own clothes from their photo. Never blend the two faces, never swap hair, glasses or clothes between them, and never put both subjects in the same square. If an image shows an animal, that square shows that same animal in the Santa hat, sized for it and sitting between or over its ears, with its own face, fur and markings, not a person. Warm, soft, flattering light, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the eyes. Photo realistic, like two real phone portraits taken on the same winter evening. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark and no sticker. No frame or border around the picture: the thin white line between the two squares is the only line.

Use the uploaded image as the base. Turn this photo into a cozy Christmas profile picture of the same pet. Add a small classic red Santa hat with a thick white fur trim and a white pompom, sized for the animal and sitting naturally between or over its ears, never covering the eyes. Add soft falling snow and warm fairy lights behind. Keep the pet exactly the same, with its own expression. The pet keeps the same species and breed look, the head shape, the ears, the eye color, the fur colors, the fur length, the pattern and the markings, and any collar, tag or bandana from the photo, with the natural body volume of that animal. Compose it as a profile picture: the pet's head and chest, the face in the exact center of the frame and looking into the camera, the whole hat in view with a little room above the pompom, so a round or square profile picture crop keeps the whole head and the hat. Behind the pet: a softly blurred cozy winter evening with warm golden fairy lights glowing as round bokeh and a hint of a decorated Christmas tree, and big soft snowflakes falling, a few resting on the hat and the fur. Warm, soft light, sharp focus on the eyes, every hair of the fur crisp. Photo realistic, like a real phone portrait taken on a winter evening. Exactly the animals in the photo, no people. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no sticker, no frame and no border.
